description: This file contains utility functions for generating OpenAPI schema definitions and request/response components for a FastAPI application. It includes functions for constructing security schemes, request parameters, responses, operation IDs, and full OpenAPI paths and specifications, leveraging FastAPI's internal models, dependencies, and routing information.

classes.name: OpenAPI
classes.description: Model representing the OpenAPI schema structure used for serialization of the generated API specification.

methods.description: Generates a complete OpenAPI schema dictionary for a given set of FastAPI routes, including paths, components, tags, and external documentation.
